statement: The count of 3,664 distinct judgments is too high because scanned copies of a common judgment are not detected. Three sets found by the reviewer: Delhi HC 08.07.2011 LA.APP 784/2005 & connected (20 files, one judgment), Delhi HC 18.05.2011 W.P.(C) 3024/2011 & connected (4 files, one judgment), Delhi HC 20.11.2008 WP(C) 5946/2007 & connected (6 files, one judgment). Net effect -27, and +1 for an undetected composite (081a8b226793 also holds an order of 13.11.2009).
evidence: Each scanned file is a one-page 'For orders, see <lead case>' sheet followed by the same judgment, with the lead-case footer 'Page N of 19' (or 'of 8') on every page; text hashes differ only because they are OCR layers. Sha prefixes: 2011-07-08 set = all 20 Delhi files of that date; 2011-05-18 = 455c9c75, 6069c60f, 75f7c670, b95440b8; 2008-11-20 = 081a8b22, 3b347f95, 664ecaf6, 781f346a, 79dfb85b, 90a7bf5a. README lists these only as weak 'cover sheet' boundary candidates.
requested_action: Add a scan-aware identity step (pointer line on p.1, lead-case running footer, court, date, page count; confirm on page renders) and merge these three sets; record 081a8b226793 as a composite; restate the count. The reviewer scan was limited to files sharing court and metadata date, so treat the corrected figure as an upper bound until this step runs on the whole corpus.

statement: STGX-48cde9cce413 is held apart as 'one 6-page Delhi judgment whose crawler dates differ'. The seven files are one order dated 20.04.2026 and should be one entity (-6). The differing dates are metadata errors: the metadata issue_date (2025) is not the date of the stored document.
evidence: Text identical after masking the download time stamp; order printed '% 20.04.2026 ... batch of 18 writ petitions, which have already been disposed of ... listed for compliance'; all seven source_urls end _2026-04-20.pdf; C10 metadata audit already marks date_status=DIFFERS for all seven.
requested_action: Merge the seven files; correct the README description; route the seven issue_date values (and the fact that these records hold a compliance order, not the disposal judgment) to the metadata workstream.

statement: The J&K 260-page judgment of 03.11.2025 (34 + 10 copies) is one judgment and should be merged (-1). The number guard fails because quote glyphs are extracted as digits; the same substitutions were accepted in three merged groups, so the guard behaves inconsistently.

statement: The 'incomplete copy' rule (first page similarity >= 0.95, same court, date, page count) is unsafe as a general rule: different cases decided by word-identical orders on the same day reach 0.96-0.99. The five merges made with it are correct.
evidence: Reviewer scan: 567 pairs of different-case files with >= 0.90 shared text and no shared case number (e.g. P&H CWP-18695/18766-2025 at 0.989). The five STGI groups were verified on every readable page.
requested_action: Require an equal case-number set on p.1, or a match on all readable pages, before merging.
